subject: Bacterial Metabolites Rewrite Host Insulin Signaling Through Acid Sphingomyelinase Induction
script: From Agewell Brief: Bacterial Metabolites Rewrite Host Insulin Signaling Through Acid Sphingomyelinase Induction. By altering bacterial pyruvate metabolism, dietary sugar shifts host lifespan and development in C. elegans through a single sphingomyelin enzyme.
